interpretations.label: Total Worldwide Box Office Gross
interpretations.description: Sum of global theatrical box office gross revenue for all movies featuring the actor in a leading or major role.
interpretations.measurableDefinition: Gross revenue in USD (unadjusted for inflation)
caveats: Does not account for ticket price inflation over time
Includes ensemble casts where the actor's individual contribution to ticket sales is variable

interpretations.label: Total Domestic Box Office Gross
interpretations.description: Sum of North American (United States and Canada) theatrical box office revenue for films featuring the actor.
interpretations.measurableDefinition: Gross revenue in USD (unadjusted for inflation)
caveats: Excludes international markets which often represent a significant portion of modern earnings
Subject to historical distortions in ticket pricing and distribution footprints

interpretations.label: Inflation-Adjusted Total Box Office Gross
interpretations.description: Cumulative global or domestic box office revenue adjusted to a baseline modern currency year to allow historical comparison.
interpretations.measurableDefinition: Adjusted gross revenue in constant USD
caveats: Adjustment methodology can vary across different economic models and historical baselines

preferredSources: Industry trade publications (Variety, The Hollywood Reporter)
knownRisks: Historical data prior to the modern studio era (and centuries prior to cinema invention specified in the range) is non-existent or speculative
Inconsistent credit definitions (lead vs. supporting vs. cameo) across aggregate tracking databases
